Statements, variables and operators. Each case's script/main exports main(); see script_test.go.

=== expressions keep their meaning
-- script/main --
export function main(): string {
  return "slime-" + str(4 % 3) + (1 + 2 * 3 == 7 ? "!" : "?")
}
-- want --
"slime-1!"

=== let, const and inference
-- script/main --
export function main(): number {
  let a = 2
  const b: number = 3
  let c: number
  c = a * b
  return c
}
-- want --
6

=== compound assignment and increments
-- script/main --
export function main(): number {
  let x = 10
  x += 5
  x -= 1
  x *= 2
  x /= 4
  x %= 4
  x++
  ++x
  x--
  return x
}
-- want --
4

=== strings grow with +=
-- script/main --
export function main(): string {
  let s = "a"
  s += 1
  s += true
  return s
}
-- want --
"a1true"

=== if, else if, else
-- script/main --
function grade(n: number): string {
  if (n >= 90) {
    return "a"
  } else if (n >= 50) {
    return "b"
  } else {
    return "c"
  }
}
export function main(): string {
  return grade(95) + grade(60) + grade(1)
}
-- want --
"abc"

=== while with break and continue
-- script/main --
export function main(): number {
  let i = 0
  let sum = 0
  while (true) {
    i++
    if (i > 10) { break }
    if (i % 2 == 0) { continue }
    sum += i
  }
  return sum
}
-- want --
25

=== for loops
-- script/main --
export function main(): number {
  let total = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < i; j++) {
      total += 1
    }
  }
  return total
}
-- want --
10

=== for of
-- script/main --
export function main(): string {
  let out = ""
  for (const w of ["a", "b", "c"]) {
    out += w
  }
  return out
}
-- want --
"abc"

=== semicolons are optional, and allowed
-- script/main --
export function main(): number { let a = 1; let b = 2; return a + b; }
-- want --
3

=== return on its own line returns nothing
-- script/main --
import { log } from "test"
function f(): void {
  return
  log("never")
}
export function main(): number {
  f()
  return 1
}
-- want --
1
-- logs --

=== comments
-- script/main --
// a line comment
/* a block
   comment */
export function main(): number { return /* inline */ 1 }
-- want --
1

=== strings in single quotes with escapes
-- script/main --
export function main(): string { return 'it\'s\t"x"\n' }
-- want --
"it's\t\"x\"\n"

=== === and !== are == and !=
-- script/main --
export function main(): bool { return 1 === 1 && "a" !== "b" }
-- want --
true

=== recursion
-- script/main --
function fib(n: number): number {
  if (n < 2) { return n }
  return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
}
export function main(): number { return fib(15) }
-- want --
610

=== the standard library computes
-- script/main --
export function main(): string {
  return concat(str(min(3, 1, 2)), str(max(1, 9)), str(clamp(5, 0, 2)), str(round(2.5)), str(int("7.9")), str(len("héllo")))
}
-- want --
"192375"

=== module constants
-- script/main --
const BASE = 10
const DOUBLE: number = BASE * 2
const NAME = "x" + str(DOUBLE)
export function main(): string { return NAME }
-- want --
"x20"

=== a constant can't change
-- script/main --
const A = 1
export function main(): number {
  A = 2
  return A
}
-- compile error --
script/main:3:3: A is a constant

=== a const variable can't change
-- script/main --
export function main(): number {
  const a = 1
  a = 2
  return a
}
-- compile error --
script/main:3:3: a is a constant

=== operators are typed at compile time
-- script/main --
export function main(): number { return 1 - "x" }
-- compile error --
script/main:1:43: - wants numbers

=== comparisons don't mix kinds
-- script/main --
export function main(): bool { return 1 == "1" }
-- compile error --
== compares a number with a string

=== division by zero fails when it runs
-- script/main --
export function main(): number {
  let z = 0
  return 1 / z
}
-- eval error --
script/main:3:12: division by zero

=== every path returns
-- script/main --
export function main(): number {
  if (true) { return 1 }
}
-- compile error --
main doesn't return a value on every path

=== void functions return nothing
-- script/main --
function f(): void { return 1 }
export function main(): number { return 1 }
-- compile error --
f returns nothing

=== a statement must do something
-- script/main --
export function main(): number {
  let a = 1
  a == 2
  return a
}
-- compile error --
script/main:3:3: this does nothing

=== break outside a loop
-- script/main --
export function main(): number {
  break
  return 1
}
-- compile error --
break and continue are only in loops

=== unknown names
-- script/main --
export function main(): number { return nope }
-- compile error --
script/main:1:41: unknown name nope

=== a module has no variables
-- script/main --
let counter = 0
-- compile error --
script/main:1:1: a module can't have variables

=== module constants are primitive
-- script/main --
const XS = [1, 2]
export function main(): number { return 1 }
-- compile error --
a module constant is a number, string or bool

=== there is no undefined
-- script/main --
export function main(): number { return undefined }
-- compile error --
script/main:1:41: unexpected "undefined"

=== the standard library can't be redeclared
-- script/main --
function min(a: number): number { return a }
export function main(): number { return 1 }
-- compile error --
min is already declared

=== strings stop at the limit
-- script/main --
export function main(): string {
  let s = "0123456789"
  while (true) { s += s }
  return s
}
-- eval error --
a string longer than 4096 characters

=== an endless loop stops at the step budget
-- script/main --
export function main(): number {
  let i = 0
  while (true) { i++ }
  return i
}
-- eval error --
ran more than 100000 steps

=== deep recursion stops at the depth budget
-- script/main --
function down(n: number): number { return down(n + 1) }
export function main(): number { return down(0) }
-- eval error --
calls nested deeper than 64

=== numbers may group their digits
-- script/main --
const MILLION = 1_000_000
export function main(): number {
  let budget = 2_500.5
  budget += 0.000_5
  return MILLION + budget
}
-- want --
1002500.5005

=== a digit separator goes between digits
-- script/main --
export function main(): number { return 1_000_ }
-- compile error --
script/main:1:46: a _ in a number goes between two digits
